title: After a gathering, a "Did you make it?" check-in records attendance and carries the Circle's next date and a bring-a-friend link

source.ref: Frequency Launch Build Brief, owner, 2026-10-06; gap report /mnt/project-files/launch/2026-10-06-launch-sweep.md

detail: WORKSTREAM 6 of the launch brief (ADR-1720). Done when the check-in records attendance. TODAY: self check-in exists only inside the event window (checkInEvent, app/(main)/events/actions.ts:1715). Hosts can mark present (attended_at / attended_by on event_rsvps and event_tickets, lib/events/attendance.ts, ADR-1332). The interest_followup trait (lib/traits/registry.ts:247) promises "a post-event email that thanks guests and points at the next date" but no sender exists. THE FIX: a cron after each gathering ends sends RSVPs (members and guests) "Did you make it?" with yes/no; yes records attendance through the same attendance seam (marked as self-reported, so the host mark stays the north-star source), and the message carries the Circle's next date and a bring-a-friend invite link. Member-facing: help line and changelog entry.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const q=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=="node_modules")walk(q,o)}else if(/\.(tsx?|mjs|md)$/.test(e.name))o.push(q)}return o};const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const ID="LIVE-803";const crons=walk("app/api/cron").filter(f=>/Did you make it/i.test(r(f))||walk(p.dirname(f)).some(g=>/Did you make it/i.test(r(g))));const libs=walk("lib").filter(f=>/Did you make it/i.test(r(f)));if(!crons.length&&!libs.length)fail(ID+": nothing asks \"Did you make it?\" after a gathering");const all=[...libs,...crons].map(r).join("\n");if(!/attend/i.test(all))fail(ID+": the check-in does not record attendance");if(!/(invite|bring a friend)/i.test(all))fail(ID+": the check-in carries no bring-a-friend link")'
verify.note: Fails until a post-event "Did you make it?" message exists, writes attendance and carries an invite link.
